name: shape-context
title: Shape Context
description: Radius variants with progressive superellipse(1.5) corners, round fallbacks, and explicit circular scopes.

html.transitioning *, html.transitioning.transition: border-radius 180ms ease-in-out, background-color 180ms ease-in-out, color 180ms ease-in-out, border-color 180ms ease-in-out, fill 180ms ease-in-out, stroke 180ms ease-in-out !important
